| Status | `429 Too Many Requests` |
| Type | `https://bitrealm.io/vault/developer/reference/errors/rate-limited` |

The vault refused an authentication attempt because the same username has tried too often: more than 20 attempts to sign in, register or claim the vault inside 60 seconds. Wait the number of seconds in the `Retry-After` header (repeated as `retry_after` in the body) and try again.
